name: Pyra the Hellborn
source:
Pyra the Hellborn is a mutant supervillain enveloped in the flames of her own rage, with incandescent and lethal powers that turn every fight into a hell. Daughter of a notorious human criminal, she decided to follow in his footsteps, adding a devastating arsenal of superhuman abilities to her destiny. Unpredictable and ruthless, Pyra embodies the fire of vengeance and the legacy of chaos.
